What to Expect

A warm and friendly, Christ-centered worship, practical teaching from God’s Word, and a community that cares.

Arrive

Friendly greeters will meet you at the door.

Worship

Music, prayer, and a Bible-based message.

Learn

Relevant, Christ-centered teaching.

Connect

Meet new people and get involved.

Parking

Free parking is available on site, with accessible parking near the entrance.

What to Wear

Come as you are. You’ll see a range from casual to business attire.

Kids & Families

Sabbath School classes are available for children and youth.

Frequently Asked Questions

What time is the service?
Worship begins Saturdays at 11:00 AM. Arriving 10–15 minutes early gives you time to park, find a seat, and meet a few people.
Where should I park?
Free on-site parking is available at 1576 Fairview Ave. A greeter at the main entrance will point you the right way.
What about my children?
Children and youth are warmly welcome. Ask a greeter about children’s programs, and about Pathfinders for ages 10–15.
Do I need to be a Seventh-day Adventist to attend?
Not at all. Whether you are a lifelong believer, curious, or still asking questions, you are welcome here.
Is there wheelchair accessibility?
Please call us at (215) 657-8364 and we will gladly help make your visit comfortable.
